body: Bitcoin is edging higher, trading near $61,373, as a confluence of structural catalysts underpins a multi-day recovery from late June lows near $57,800. The primary driver is a landmark joint SEC/CFTC ruling classifying 16 major digital assets — including Bitcoin — as non-security commodities, removing long-standing legal ambiguity and unlocking potential institutional demand. Macro tailwinds from a weaker-than-expected June jobs report (57K vs. 114K expected) and Fed Chair Warsh's dovish [...] Bitcoin is edging higher, trading near $63,200 as it consolidates above the key 200-week moving average (~$62,600) following a sharp recovery from late-June lows near $58,000–$59,000. The recent rebound has been fueled by a weak June nonfarm payrolls print (57,000 vs. ~110,000 expected), which eased Fed rate-hike fears, while U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs snapped a brutal 10-day outflow streak with $221.7M in net inflows led by Fidelity's FBTC. Adding to the narrative, JP Morgan flagged potential [...] Bitcoin is holding steady near $64,300, edging modestly higher as investors digest the Fed's July 29 decision to hold rates at 3.50%-3.75% amid a rare three-way hawkish dissent favoring a hike. BTC briefly dropped to $62,383 post-FOMC before rebounding, though it remains capped below $66,500 as renewed US-Iran tensions, a 6.6% oil spike, and another delay to the CLARITY Act's Senate passage keep risk appetite in check.
